cases.label: derived (no overrides)
cases.note: $199.23 is the output of these assumptions, not a fact about Apple Inc. It assumes a WACC of 9.63%, an equity risk premium of 4.41%, and 4.00% growth in perpetuity. The equity risk premium is Damodaran's implied premium, computed from what the S&P 500 costs today against the cash flows it is expected to produce (November 2026); a different but defensible premium moves the figure materially, and the sensitivity table shows by how much. The growth in perpetuity defaults to the lowest of the risk-free rate, long-run US nominal growth and the discount rate less three points, and that is as high as it can be set: it can be moved down but not up.
